note: WAEC CRS round 5 (R27 top-up): Joseph's dreams/cup/Judah's pledge; holy ground, Aaron the spokesman, Passover blood; manna, Meribah, bronze serpent, Joshua and Caleb; Deborah, Gideon's 300, Samson's hair; Saul's spoils, David's sling, Nathan's ewe lamb, Solomon's baby, Rehoboam and Jeroboam's calves at Bethel and Dan; fire at Carmel, Naaman's seven washings, Isaiah's coal, Jeremiah's reluctance, Ezekiel's dry bones; the fiery furnace and fourth man, lions' den, MENE TEKEL UPHARSIN; wise men's gifts, the beloved Son, the three temptations, feeding five thousand, Lazarus after four days, transfiguration with Moses and Elijah; sower's thorns, the good Samaritan, prodigal's fatted calf; cock's crow, Emmaus bread, Pentecost fire, Ananias and Sapphira, Stephen's vision, Damascus road, Peter's sheet and Cornelius.
